correctness.rationale: Artin–Schreier pole order 9 proves genus four, the trace-one obstruction over F64 forces N3=N1=1, hence B3=0. Weil bounds and divisor counting prove B_r>0 for every genus-four curve over F4 and all integers r>=4. Equality in Weil lower bound determines all eight eigenvalues; independent exact programs reproduce N1,N2,N3,N4 and first four B_r. The finite computations are not used as a substitute for the all-r argument.
